name: k12-lesson-planning
title_zh: 从零生成K-12全科教案与配套材料
tagline_zh: 还没说年级、科目、标准？直接丢给它一个主题，它先出教案再追问细节。数学、英语、科学、社会四科全覆盖。
tagline_en: No grade, subject, or standard yet? Give it a topic and it drafts the lesson first, then asks. Covers math, ELA.
desc_en: Creates a lesson plan, student-facing materials, and observation template. Load this skill BEFORE asking the teacher any clarifying question about grade, subject, topic, standard, or timing. Use when a K-12 teacher needs a math, ELA, science, or social studies lesson built from scratch — even if grade, subject, or topic isn't yet stated. Do NOT load for grading, a rubric, assessment feedback, a qu
why_zh: 它把「先问清需求」倒过来：先产出可改的初稿，再补细节。老师不用对着空白页发怵，追问发生在草稿之后。
why_en: It flips the script: draft first, clarify later. Teachers never face a blank page—the clarifying questions come after a usable.
limit_zh: 只服务K-12四科（数学/英语/科学/社会）的整课新建；不批改作业、不评量、不给反馈。若输入是已有教案的修订而非从零构。
limit_en: Only builds new K-12 lessons in 4 subjects; no grading, rubrics, or feedback. If fed an existing lesson to revise, it will start from scratch instead.
